name: seoso
description: SEOSO website: standalone Sanity Studio (studio/) + Next.js site (web/)

scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix studio && npm install --prefix web
scripts.start: concurrently --names web,studio --prefix-colors blue,magenta --kill-others-on-fail "cd web && npm run dev" "cd studio && npm run dev"
scripts.check: npm run typegen && cd web && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build
